name: 区位（交通/配套/规划）评估

map.房地产区位条件评估工具，从交通便利度、教育配套、医疗配套、商业配套、环境质量和规: A location assessment tool scoring six dimensions: transport convenience, education, medical care, retail, environmental quality and planning outlook.
map.📖 查看「区位（交通/配套/规划）评估 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Location Assessment (Transport / Amenities / Planning) User Guide"
map.区位评估总分 = 交通便利度 + 教育配套 + 医疗配套 + 商业配套 + 环境: Location score = transport + education + medical + retail + environment + planning outlook (0 to 5 each, 30 in total); weighted score = Σ dimension score ÷ 5 × weight (weights 25, 20, 15, 15, 15, 10); 25 or above is a prime location, 20-24 good, 15-19 average and below 15 poor.
map.区位是房地产价值的核心影响因素: Location is the core driver of real estate value
map.交通便利度权重最高(25%)，是区位评估的首要因素: Transport convenience carries the highest weight (25%) and is the primary factor in location assessment
map.教育配套对住宅价值影响显著，学区房溢价明显: Education has a marked effect on residential value and school-catchment homes command a clear premium
map.规划前景反映区域未来发展潜力: Planning outlook reflects the area's future growth potential
map.拿地前对交通、配套、规划六维打分选优。: Score transport, amenities and planning across six dimensions to pick the best site before land acquisition.
map.同板块多地块横向比较加权得分。: Compare weighted scores across several plots in the same submarket.
map.识别短板维度（如环境差）针对性规避。: Identify weak dimensions (poor environment, say) and avoid them deliberately.
map.交通 5、教育 4、医疗 4、商业 3、环境 3、规划 4（满分各 5）→ 原始: Transport 5, education 4, medical 4, retail 3, environment 3, planning 4 (5 max each) gives a raw score of 23/30, good; weighted by 25/20/15/15/15/10 = 5/5×25 + 4/5×20 + 4/5×15 + 3/5×15 + 3/5×15 + 4/5×10 = 79/100.
map.若环境、商业均≤2 分则列入短板，建议避开或要求降价；权重最高的是交通便利度（2: Where environment and retail both score 2 or less they are flagged as weaknesses: avoid the site or ask for a lower price. Transport convenience carries the highest weight (25%), so plots at metro entrances are clearly advantaged.
map.权重为什么交通最高？: Why does transport carry the highest weight?
map.房产价值中交通可达性对需求影响最大，故权重 25% 居首，其次教育与医疗。: Accessibility shapes demand more than anything else in property value, so 25% ranks first, followed by education and medical care.
map.加权分和原始分差很多？: Why do the weighted and raw scores differ a lot?
map.原始分看绝对水平，加权分体现各维度重要度，规划前景权重仅 10% 但影响长期增值: The raw score shows the absolute level while the weighted score reflects how much each dimension matters; planning outlook is weighted only 10% but drives long-term appreciation, so read them together.
map.房地产区位评估工具从交通、教育、医疗、商业、环境和规划6个维度对区位条件进行加权: The location tool scores transport, education, medical care, retail, environment and planning on a weighted basis to assess locational value and appreciation potential.
